note: Community videos on the home page. Append an entry, then run: python3 tools/brand/community_videos.py (rewrites the row in index.html). id = YouTube video id; thumb = file in website/media (1280x720 copy of the video's own thumbnail, so nothing loads from YouTube before a click). caption = OUR one line (never the video's own title); by = the creator's channel name, channel = its link. check_marks.py must stay clean.
